notes.title: We're moving Forward. Our new game will be released on June 13, 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that our new video game, [i][b]Asteroid Forward[/b][/i], will be released on [i]Steam[/i] and on Android mobile devices via the [i]Google Play Store[/i] on [b]June 13, 2025![/b]

[previewyoutube=sZbe-tPr9fc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Z9 galaxy is back—this time in the palm of your hand (or on that beast of a gaming PC you’ve got). Face tons of enemies one after another, complete the available Planets, and upgrade your spaceship by gathering more and more resources as you explore the entire galaxy!

[b]You can already try the public beta version[/b] available on the [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alestore.asteroidforward]Google Play Store[/url].
Please note that your save data from the public beta will be deleted at launch, cross-save will not be supported at launch (although cross-play will be), and any content may vary from the final release.

It’s a free-to-play game with ads and completely optional in-app purchases, as the game is fully enjoyable even without spending a single cent.

Asteroid Forward is everything Asteroid never was, due to our lack of experience (it was our very first game!), and that’s why we decided to start from scratch, creating a complete experience right from the launch, more contained and tailored to our abilities. It’s not the super ambitious open-world live service we once envisioned for the original Asteroid, but rather a more casual game that includes all the elements we originally wanted to feature.

Asteroid is engraved in our hearts, but we were unable to continue its development for a number of reasons over time—limited resources and our inexperience being the main ones. It’s not a promise, but we do intend to completely redesign the original experience from the ground up in the near future.

Thank you for reading, and we’ll see you in the Z9 galaxy!

– Alessandro

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3754700/Asteroid_Forward/

notes.title: An Update from Alestore Games
notes.notes:
Good morning everyone,

We would like to inform you about our upcoming projects and updates.

We regret to inform you that the online multiplayer mode of [i][b]Dragonium Adventure[/b][/i] will be delayed, and therefore this mode will be temporarily removed from the game's main menu to avoid confusion among players. We are working to provide you with a high-quality experience and thank you for your patience and understanding.

Additionally, we are working on a [b]paid DLC[/b] for [i][b]Dragonium Adventure[/b][/i] which will be available soon. Stay tuned for more details!

In the meantime, during 2025 we will release [i][b]Asteroid: Forward[/b][/i], a free-to-play spin-off of the [i]Asteroid[/i] series for smart devices running Android. A new trailer will be released soon to announce the game's launch date and give you a more detailed preview of what to expect.

As for the original [i][b]Asteroid[/b][/i], which launched on [i]Steam[/i] in 2022 in early access, a dedicated announcement about our future plans for the title will be published soon.

As a final announcement, we would like to inform you that we are working on [b]an entirely new project[/b], the details of which will be revealed in the future. Stay tuned to learn more!

Thank you for your continued support.

Alestore Games

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1.0 for Dragonium Adventure
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes for Dragonium Adventure 1.1.0!

Additions and Improvements:

[list]
[*] Improved RUSH Mode. After defeating a boss, you can now choose one reward from three options:

[list]
[*] Increase the Item Indicator by 1;
[*] Additional Medal corresponding to the defeated boss;
[*] Ability to choose the next encounter's enemy at random, making it easier to farm specific Medagliemax (excluding bosses).
[/list]
[*] Enhanced audio options in the Settings menu. A dedicated menu can now be opened to adjust the volume of music and sound effects.
[*] Added an indicator for stat increases/decreases when using combat techniques with stat-altering effects.
[*] Added an indicator for the remaining turns of currently applied status effects in battle.
[*] Added a character level indicator when viewing the victory screen.
[*] Mana is no longer consumed if an attack fails due to a status effect such as paralysis/freeze.
[*] Updated and improved some combat technique descriptions.
[*] Added an animation related to the Super Heart turn indicator.
[*] The Super Heart will no longer charge if the attack fails.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where activating Royal Guardian Kael's (Amyna) skill caused the game to freeze without passing to the next turn during the battle with Royal Guardian Aehtra, forcing the player to close and reopen the game.
[*] Fixed an issue related to the visual damage indicator. After defeating an enemy, it would still attack after the victory screen was displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue with the background in the RUSH mode start screen, where it would not be set correctly according to the day/night cycle preferences.
[*] Fixed translation issues.
[*] Resolved minor bugs.
[/list]

Balance Changes:

[list]
[*] Rockfall
Damage: 12 / 16 ⮕ 11 / 15  
Effect: -1 SPD (self) ⮕ -1 SPD (enemy)
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy Dragonium Adventure!

notes.title: Play Dragonium Adventure anywhere you want on Steam Deck! (GUIDE)
notes.notes:
In this post, we will cover the compatibility of [b][i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] on Steam Deck[/b]. We will update this guide frequently to ensure that all players can play without issues on Steam Deck, aiming to minimize the steps required.

Unfortunately, at the time of writing, [b][i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] has not yet been officially verified by Valve on Steam Deck[/b], but this doesn’t mean it can’t be played perfectly without issues! Just follow these three small steps, and you'll be ready to launch the game.

[h1]How to play Dragonium Adventure on Steam Deck[/h1]  
Here are the steps to play [i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] on Steam Deck:
 
[olist]  
[*] In the [b]main menu of Steam Deck[/b] or your [b]Steam library[/b], select [i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] to enter the [b]game page[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/7a6b3af038ff3c515a3e3dbc4dac6074614249af.jpg[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/45aca37cd409442d9c395db60157699857bb7402.jpg[/img]

[*] Select the button with [b]the gear-shaped icon to open Steam's "Properties..." for the game[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/96a006a31cab8d6aef634fa839c6401282c4a516.jpg[/img]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/43f9e71214885e442a3e558beffe741911f7c314.jpg[/img]

[*] In the [b]side menu[/b], select [b]"Compatibility"[/b].

[b]Make sure the "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" box is checked[/b], and [b]select a version of Proton from the dropdown menu[/b].  
The version we recommend is [b]Proton 9.0-3 or higher[/b]. Older versions may not work properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/30493973e16919e3c1f5acd2b384df441f065d66.jpg[/img]  
[/olist]  
Done! [b]You won’t need to repeat this process in the future[/b]. Now, all that’s left is to launch [i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] and begin your adventure in the kingdom of Akinori!

[h2]Why is this process necessary?[/h2]  
If you own a Steam Deck, you may already have heard of Steam Play and Proton in particular.

Proton is a compatibility tool that allows applications developed for other operating systems to run on Linux and SteamOS, the operating system used by Steam Deck.

Before deciding to use Proton, we attempted to develop a native Linux build, but it experienced some performance issues, such as longer initial loading times (estimated to be more than double compared to the Windows version, even with Proton) and save data compatibility with Steam Cloud.

One of our priorities has always been to allow save data transfer between devices so that you can resume your game exactly where you left off on another device, such as your home PC.

Since most Steam Deck owners also have a primary PC, we made Steam Cloud one of our priorities for the Linux version.

Proton solved both issues: loading times were halved, and save data cloud syncing with Steam Cloud works perfectly.

The only requirement for the user is to select a Proton version in the game settings on Steam before launching the game.

At the moment, it is not possible to launch the game on Steam Deck without first selecting a Proton version. The game will not start, and it will return to the game page in the Steam library after a few seconds, without showing any errors.

We have already contacted Valve and are awaiting their response to understand how to proceed. All we would need is to set a default Proton version at game launch, avoiding this step for users and allowing them to simply download the game and launch it directly.

For any issues, remember you can contact us at [url=mailto:alestoregames@gmail.com]alestoregames@gmail.com[/url] or by opening a ticket in the [url=https://discord.gg/ZGzZXQXgGs]official Dragonium Adventure Discord server[/url] with your request.

We will periodically update this post if we have any news.

Last updated: 10-24-2024 12:00 AM (CEST).

notes.title: Dragonium Adventure takes part in the Steam Next Fest with a new DEMO!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/48264f41f15613930ab60c205bf5e246ef8cee7b.png[/img]

Happy Steam Next Fest to everyone!

This year, [i]Dragonium Adventure[/i] is participating in the [b]February 2024 edition[/b] with a [b]free update to the previously released DEMO version[/b]. Let's dive into the details to discover the new features!

[h1]Explore the Akinori Plain and the Krakos Desert![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/8ede1edc9227e72789e2ae1094e81504a30c12f5.png[/img]
Compared to the previous DEMO version, this time you can explore not just one but [b]two brand new areas![/b] The lush [b]Akinori Plain[/b] and the challenging [b]Krakos Desert[/b] await you in this new update: defeat all the enemies, mini-bosses, and bosses that inhabit these areas and acquire new combat techniques to enhance your skills in battle!

[h1]Face Krakos the Giant![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/2d049eb507526554e47ff09e3ce535f5aa6a985d.png[/img]
In addition to Erpon, the Reptile of the Plain, will you also manage to defeat the [b]imposing Krakos?[/b] The sovereign of the Akinori Desert is very powerful, and to defeat him, you'll need to adopt a [b]winning strategy[/b]. Show him what you're made of, Royal Knight!

[h1]New combat techniques added![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/c8148a150f4fba508d4c7b500c95588ab6446799.png[/img]
Face enemies with a variety of [b]combat techniques[/b] that you'll acquire battle after battle from the Tree of Knowledge in exchange for valuable [b]Skill Points[/b]. We don't want to spoil which new techniques we've introduced in the game, it's up to you to discover them! Just know that in this new DEMO, you can try [b]up to a total of 11 combat techniques![/b]

[h1]Try out the new Rush Mode![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/3d23deb930c0c380aca6390e3feba7091d9e472f.png[/img]
Do you want to test your skills? Think you can handle yourself well in battles?

[b]Once you've completed the Story Mode in the updated DEMO version and acquired all the combat techniques[/b], you can challenge yourself in the [b]Rush Mode[/b]: a demanding test where you'll be the protagonist of an [b]endless series of battles[/b], one after another. You must master the [b]randomly generated moveset[/b] that will be assigned to you. [b]After each victory[/b], a randomly chosen slot will be [b]replaced with another combat technique[/b], which is also randomly selected!

Adapt to the moveset and try to defeat as many opponents as possible in this challenging game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/5b467ecef24a02419b8d62d10730d99434c06418.png[/img]
As announced earlier, [b]this will be the final update of the DEMO version of Dragonium Adventure[/b], and [b]it will be available for a limited time only[/b], from February 5, 2024, to February 12, 2024.

We hope you enjoy this new DEMO version and can't wait to dive into the world of Akinori!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210050/Dragonium_Adventure/

notes.title: Dragonium Adventure FREE DEMO UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/3fb443d4d68323a38aa6f64c62abc7a5bf120090.png[/img]

We are proud to present you the [b]first update of the free DEMO version of Dragonium Adventure available now on Steam![/b]

In this updated version, you will be able to play the [b]first 5 levels of the game's story mode[/b], but with a twist! In fact, [b]new combat techniques have been added[/b] and [b]statuses have been introduced, such as paralysis and freezing![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/6d13513d365c967e801cac3f4da0943063f35fbf.png[/img]
Statuses can be inflicted on enemies with some special combat techniques: [b]Boltstorm can inflict paralysis[/b], while [b]Cryoblast can inflict freezing[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/4946dacfc1fdb3518dc4ab73e3c902c9cbd13a48.png[/img]
These two statuses are quite similar, [b]they don't allow the opponent to attack for a few turns in case the technique takes effect[/b]. However, [b]the effect is not always guaranteed[/b], and sometimes even using a technique that inflicts status on the opponent [b]may not hit as expected![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/ea760f9f05bb8d027cfda676dc006632037177ac.png[/img]
As for [b]Cryoblast[/b], it can [b]freeze the opponent for a few turns less than the paralysis inflicted by Boltstorm[/b]. However, [b]if the opponent is frozen and a Fire element technique is used[/b], the opponent will no longer be frozen and [b]will be dealt double damage during the attack![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182276/c34bf353490f6619238e7f51c798019bc86c8a72.png[/img]

We hope you can't wait to enter the world of Akinori!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210050/Dragonium_Adventure/
